{# Open Graph and Twitter card tags. Material ships none of these, so every link to this site - every summary and explainer - previewed in Slack, X, LinkedIn and iMessage as a bare URL with no title, no description and no image. mkdocs-material has a `social` plugin that renders a per-page card, but it pulls in Cairo and Pillow as build dependencies and needs system libraries installed on the runner; static tags against one committed card image get most of the benefit for none of that, and cannot break the build. The image is assets/brand/social-preview-1280x640.png, rendered from assets/brand/social-preview.html and the same file uploaded to GitHub's own social preview, so the repo and the site present identically. Ported from the sibling zero-to-hero site on 2026-09-30. NOTE: this couples the site to Material's template structure - it extends base.html and fills its `extrahead` block. After a mkdocs-material bump, confirm that block still exists. A --strict build will not catch its absence: missing meta tags are not an error, they just silently stop being emitted. #} {% extends "base.html" %} {# , from page.meta.seo_title set by scripts/site_hooks.py: a short "<Short name> Paper Summary (<year>)" rather than Material's "<full paper title> - Everything AI, Summarized", which search results cut off. #} {% block htmltitle %} {% if page and page.meta and page.meta.seo_title %} <title>{{ page.meta.seo_title }} {% else %} {{ super() }} {% endif %} {% endblock %} {% block extrahead %} {% set title = config.site_name %} {% if page and page.meta and page.meta.seo_title %} {% set title = page.meta.seo_title %} {% elif page and page.title and not page.is_homepage %} {% set title = page.title | striptags ~ " - " ~ config.site_name %} {% endif %} {% set description = config.site_description %} {% if page and page.meta and page.meta.description %} {% set description = page.meta.description %} {% endif %} {% set image = config.site_url ~ "assets/brand/social-preview-1280x640.png" %} {% if page and page.meta and page.meta.robots %} {% endif %} {# Search Console ownership (URL-prefix property). Empty until the token is set in mkdocs.yml `extra.google_site_verification`. #} {% if config.extra.google_site_verification %} {% endif %} {# schema.org BreadcrumbList (+ WebSite on the home page), built by scripts/site_hooks.py. #} {% if page and page.meta and page.meta.jsonld %} {% endif %} {% endblock %}
